name: Create Inventory Pool
overview: [excited] Let's create an Inventory Pool! Think of this... as a smart group for your products. [friendly] We just need a NAME, a quick description, and to pick the items. Easy!

nodes.label: Pool Name
nodes.explanation: [casual] First up, give this pool a NAME. Let's call it... voice-demo.

nodes.label: Description
nodes.demoValue: This is a custom inventory pool created during the voice assistant walkthrough.
nodes.explanation: [casual] Now, add a quick description. Just a note so everyone knows what this pool is FOR.

nodes.label: Select Products
nodes.explanation: [friendly] Time to pick the products! Let's start with... SINGLE BED SHEET.

nodes.label: Select Products
nodes.explanation: [casual] Good, let's add another. How about... DOUBLE BED SHEET.

nodes.label: Select Products
nodes.explanation: [casual] And one more to round it out... CHAIR COVER.

wrapUp: [warm and satisfied] And that's it! [chuckles] You've built your inventory pool. Nothing was saved here... but whenever you're ready, go group your REAL products. You've got this!
